🚀 Big Launches.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT-5.6 in Kiro
🚀 Big Launches.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 on the Kiro platform, offering faster inference at lower cost for code‑related tasks. Why it matters: cheaper, higher‑throughput models let developers build and test AI‑augmented software more efficiently, a hot topic in MLOps interviews.

🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.title: Wire It, Run It, Deploy It: AI Workflows in Gradio
🛠️ Builder's Toolbox.summary: Hugging Face published a guide showing how to chain prompts, data processing, and model serving using Gradio’s free UI components. Why it matters: mastering Gradio speeds up prototype demos, a common interview assignment.

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Instinct’s powerful AI assistant is raising privacy and security concerns
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: TechCrunch reports that Instinct’s assistant, while feature‑rich, collects broad user data and can act autonomously, sparking privacy red flags. Why it matters: highlights the need to design AI with clear data‑handling policies, a frequent responsible‑AI interview question.

tool_of_day.title: Gradio – Open‑source UI for ML demos
tool_of_day.summary: A free Python library that lets you turn models into interactive web apps in minutes, ideal for building portfolio projects and interview demos.

hot_take: Today's mix of high‑performance model releases, rapid‑deployment tools, and privacy scrutiny signals that interview‑ready candidates must blend cost‑aware MLOps skills, fast prototyping with Gradio, and a solid grounding in responsible AI.
